data.exceptions: Only the owner may apply an exception this policy defines (an accident, urgent necessary work, or another unforeseeable emergency). A worker's agreement or a manager's request is not an exception.
data.overtime: Calculated by payroll; not a scheduling input.

data.crew_authority: Not a stored gate: evaluated per person at hold and commit (competency, authority expiry through the window, apprentice supervision, rest and hours).
data.start_gates_owner: field_safety checks them at work-package issue and daily mobilization
gate_states_that_pass: cleared
waived by the owner in the owner's gate screen, with a reason
data.same_day_changes: A change of people or hours on days the current assignment already holds needs no new hold.
data.supersession: A change is a new assignment version listing only the remaining days; days already worked stay in the superseded version's history.
data.apprentice_supervision: Tenant policy: each apprentice works on the same site as a certified journeyperson named as supervisor, at most 2 apprentices per journeyperson.
data.weather_rule: A crew date is proposed or kept only when the configured forecast for the whole window is inside every sourced limit of the work type.
data.storm_rule: A storm watch never cancels or moves work by itself; the owner's storm-mode setting decides priorities.
data.unsent_notices: The first scheduler run after the customer's contact window opens proposes the send of an unsent schedule notice if its assignment, consent, and suppression facts are unchanged.
data.service_visits: Need an open service case, a verified customer, and the customer's offered windows; no deposit gate. A person working alone follows field_safety's working-alone check-ins.
